Aadhaar Card Update & Download — Complete Guide

Aadhaar me mobile number update karna hai? Online free process, documents, fees aur status check — sab kuch simple Hindi me updated.

2 min read•

Last updated: 15 Sep 2026

S
Samjho Content Team
Finance and policy experts with 5+ years of experience helping Indians understand money, documents and government schemes.

Quick Summary

  • 12-digit unique ID (UIDAI)
  • Free update online
  • Mobile + address changeable
  • myAadhaar portal self-service
  • Works as ID + address proof
In simple words:

Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI to every resident of India. It serves as proof of identity and address, and is required for most government schemes, bank accounts, PAN linkage, and mobile connections.

Simple explanation

Aadhaar card ek 12-digit ka unique identity number hai jo UIDAI (Unique Identification Authority of India) issue karta hai. Yeh proof of identity aur proof of address dono ka kaam karta hai. Har Indian resident — age, gender ya religion se bina kisi bhedbhav ke — Aadhaar ke liye apply kar sakta hai.

Aadhaar mein aapki basic demographic information (naam, date of birth, address) aur biometric information (photograph, 10 fingerprints, iris scan) store hoti hai. Yeh sab data UIDAI ke secure servers par encrypted form mein rakha jaata hai.

Aap apna Aadhaar card online download kar sakte hain UIDAI ki official website (uidai.gov.in) ya mAadhaar app se. Downloaded e-Aadhaar password-protected hota hai — password aapke 4-letter name + birth year (YYYY) ka combination hota hai.

Aadhaar mein koi bhi change — jaise address update, mobile number update, ya name correction — karwane ke liye aapko nearest Aadhaar Enrolment Centre jaana hota hai ya phir kuch changes online bhi ho jaate hain. Address update ke liye aap Self Service Update Portal (ssup.uidai.gov.in) use kar sakte hain.

Why does it matter?

Aadhaar aaj India mein almost har important kaam ke liye zaroori hai — bank account open karna, PAN card link karna, SIM card lena, government subsidies receive karna, property registration, aur bahut kuch. Bina valid Aadhaar ke aap kai essential services miss kar sakte hain.

Example

In numbers

Maan lijiye aapne apna address change kiya hai. Purana address Aadhaar mein ab galat hai. Agar aap address update nahi karwate, toh OTP-based verification fail ho sakta hai, bank KYC reject ho sakta hai, aur government scheme ka paisa aapke account mein nahi aa sakta. Isliye address change ke 30 din ke andar Aadhaar update karwa lena chahiye.

Important things to know

  • Aadhaar 12-digit unique identity number hai — har number sirf ek individual se linked hota hai.
  • UIDAI (uidai.gov.in) Aadhaar ka official authority hai. Enrolment aur update sirf authorised centres par hote hain.
  • e-Aadhaar (downloaded PDF) original Aadhaar card jitna hi valid hai — print karke use kar sakte hain.
  • Aadhaar mein address update online SSUP portal se free mein ho sakta hai, lekin name, DOB, mobile, biometric update ke liye centre visit zaroori hai.
  • Aadhaar update ke liye supporting documents zaroori hain — address proof, identity proof jo bhi change karwana ho uske according.
  • Virtual ID (VID) — ek temporary 16-digit number — bhi generate kar sakte hain jo Aadhaar ki jagah use hota hai, extra privacy ke liye.
  • mAadhaar app official mobile app hai jahan aap apna Aadhaar carry kar sakte hain.
  • Aadhaar enrolment free hai — kisi agent ko paise dene ki zaroorat nahi hai.

Common Mistakes

  • Fake websites ya agents ke through Aadhaar update karwana — sirf uidai.gov.in ya authorised centres use karein.
  • Mobile number Aadhaar se link na karna — bina linked mobile ke OTP-based services kaam nahi karti.
  • Aadhaar ko publicly share karna — Aadhaar number kisi unknown website ya form mein na daalein.
  • Name ya DOB mein spelling mistakes ko ignore karna — baad mein PAN ya bank se mismatch ho sakta hai.
  • e-Aadhaar ka password na samajhna — pehle 4 letters of name (as on Aadhaar) + birth year (YYYY) hota hai, all uppercase.

FAQs

Aadhaar card online kaise download karein?
UIDAI ki official website (uidai.gov.in) par jaayein, 'Download Aadhaar' section mein apna Aadhaar number / Enrolment ID / VID enter karein, OTP verify karein, aur e-Aadhaar PDF download ho jaayega. Password aapke name ke pehle 4 letters (UPPERCASE) + birth year (YYYY) hota hai.
Aadhaar mein address kaise update karein?
Online: SSUP portal (ssup.uidai.gov.in) par login karke, valid address proof upload karke free mein update kar sakte hain. Offline: Nearest Aadhaar Enrolment Centre par valid address proof ke saath jaayein. Update mein usually 5-90 days lagte hain.
Aadhaar mein mobile number kaise link karein?
Mobile number link karne ke liye Aadhaar Enrolment Centre jaana zaroori hai — online option available nahi hai. Centre par ek chhota form bharein, biometric verify hoga, aur mobile number link ho jaayega. Isme typically ₹30-50 lagte hain.
Aadhaar card ka status kaise check karein?
UIDAI website par 'Check Aadhaar Status' section mein apna Enrolment ID / Acknowledgement Number daalein. Agar Aadhaar already generated hai, toh 'Verify Aadhaar' section mein 12-digit Aadhaar number daal kar verify kar sakte hain.
Kya Aadhaar lost ho sakta hai ya duplicate ho sakta hai?
Aadhaar number kabhi duplicate nahi hota — ek person ka ek hi Aadhaar number hota hai. Agar Aadhaar card kho jaaye, toh aap UIDAI website ya mAadhaar app se dobara download kar sakte hain. Biometric linked hone ki wajah se identity safe rehti hai.
NRI ya foreign citizen Aadhaar le sakte hain?
NRI jo 182+ days India mein ruke hain woh Aadhaar ke liye eligible hain. Foreign citizens jo India mein resident hain (valid visa / OCI status ke saath) bhi apply kar sakte hain. Non-residents jo 182 days se kam ruke hain, woh eligible nahi hain.
